scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.unit.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.e2e:db: rm -rf .wrangler/e2e && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c wrangler.e2e.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/e2e
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run build:local && npm run test:e2e
scripts.deploy: vite build && wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
